server.name: community-nickol-knx
server.version: nickol-knx-mcp (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 576 of Frame 3, block 5. Thirty two tools, none annotated. The server writes only inside <working directory>/knx-workspace and never opens a bus connection, per workspace_info. A project is loaded from a seeded ETS group-address export (ga-export/01) by a server prelude, since the loaded project is cached for the session; load_ga_export is not under test. Generated .knxproj archives are observed by entry.
